meta.name: The Break
meta.description:
The story is set in a small village in the Ardennes, where a young African footballer is found dead. If all clues lead first to suicide, a police officer just arrived from Brussels does not take long to discover that this is a murder.

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 not on server

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Inspector Yoann Peeters and his daughter Camille move to Heiderfeld where he spend his youth. when a boy ends up dead in the river, Peeters is the only one who believes there is more to it than a suicide.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: With a confession on the books, the chief is eager to close the case. But, Peeters presses ahead, convinced the real killer is still at large.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Flouting orders, Peeters hatches a plan to find out what the Malausas are hiding. Camile gets her first taste of the local party scene.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Peeters puzzles over a disturbing find at Driss's apartment, the mystery caller gives the mayor an ultimatum, and Camile worries for Zoe's safety.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Peeters digs into shady dealings at the soccer club and braces for a difficult conversation with Ines. The chief closes in on the menacing caller.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Jeff leads Peeters and Drummer to a chilling scene in the woods. The battle over the dam takes a new turn, and Camile's frustrations boil over.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: While Peeters questions the author of the fake suicide note, the chief makes an unsettling discovery. Panic sends Kevin into a dangerous spiral.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The mystery about Driss, Heiderfeld and Yoann unravels further more. Yoann finally hears why his psychiatrist is questioning him.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Romantic revelations and news of a local's dark past shake up the investigation once again. When Sebastian goes AWOL, Marjo faces a dilemma.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As memories come flooding back to Peeters, the pieces of the puzzle begin to fall into place. But he can't shake the feeling that something is amiss.
